Prettier never reaches a fixed point on this input. With two line comments in the
`]`→value-`:` gap of a mapped type it cannot settle where the second comment goes:
it oscillates forever between `]: // c2⏎V` (second comment trailing the value `:`,
first inside the broken brackets) and `// c2⏎]: V` (second comment pulled inside
the brackets below the first), flipping on every pass. No prettier-anchored claim
file (output_prettier.*, audit_signature.txt, variants) is expressible. The
validator live-verifies this claim (rule F5). See README.md and
docs/conformance_prettier.md §Comment relocation.
